purpose: Teach: マリー/囲ん/のぼり/刻ん/年明け/回顧/実り/りょう

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、マリー王妃時代の文化、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on Queen Marie's era—the cultural focus was very thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm and measuring. Slight pause after the dash to let the praise land. Even pace, genuine regard in the voice. The tone of a teacher who has read something that surprised her in the best way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、宮廷を囲んだ装飾、写真集に。
lines.en: Yes. I included a lot of the decorative pieces that surrounded the court back then—I put them in a photo collection section.
lines.style: Modest but clear. Not rushed. A small lift of pride on 'photo collection' but quickly tempered. The tone of someone explaining a choice they're quietly confident about.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統的なのぼり、起源、章末で扱いましたね。
lines.en: And the traditional banners—you traced their origins and handled that at the end of a chapter, right?
lines.style: Engaged, conversational check-in. Light vocal lift on the question. She's genuinely interested in his organizational choices, not testing. Leaning into the discussion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史を刻んだ建築物、別章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I decided to give the historically significant architecture its own chapter so it could breathe.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. A small emphasis on 'own chapter'—he's defending a choice he made. Not defensive, just clear. Speaking as someone who thought this through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 年明けの儀式、各国の比較、興味深いですね。
lines.en: The year-opening rituals section is particularly interesting—the way you compare them across different countries.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Warm and specific praise. She's lingering on this observation because it genuinely caught her attention. Slight lean-in energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去を回顧する文学作品、引用、適切でしたか。
lines.en: The literary passages I included to reflect on the past—do you think they fit naturally?
lines.style: Careful uncertainty. Not insecure, but genuinely seeking feedback on something he cares about. A slight hesitation before the question, like he's held this one back until now.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実りある研究、卒論として相応しいですね。
lines.en: This is genuinely rich work—it's absolutely thesis-worthy.
lines.style: Clear and direct affirmation. No hedging. She means it. Measured pace, steady eye-contact level tone. The kind of praise that lands because it's earned and unadorned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資料のりょう、十分、確保できました。
lines.en: I was able to gather enough primary sources to support it all.
lines.style: Quiet relief and competence. Understated satisfaction. He's saying 'I did the work.' Not boastful, just factual. A small exhale at the end—the acknowledgment that this burden is lighter now.
